sloka: इदम् हि तेजस्तव यद्धुरत्ययम् ।तदेव जिज्ञासितु मिच्छता मया ।इमम् भवानर्थमभिप्रचोदितो ।वृणीष्व किम्चेदपरम् व्यवस्यति ॥२-३२-४०॥
transliteration: idam hi tejastava yaddhuratyayam ।tadeva jijñāsitu micchatā mayā ।imam bhavānarthamabhipracodito ।vṛṇīṣva kimcedaparam vyavasyati ॥2-32-40॥

translations.english: Afterwards Rama sought to placate Trijata, that descendant of Ganga, saying: This was a joke. Do not be angry.
